caption: The drawing features a symmetrical arrangement of stylized objects on a parchment-like background. At the top, there is a cross with flared ends, colored in gold with red outlines and blue inner accents. Directly below the cross is a bow-like shape with four loops, each outlined in blue and red, and filled with gold, converging at a circular center with a blue ring and a red cross inside. Flanking the bow are two wing-like objects, colored gold with their bottom tips shaded red. At the bottom of the composition is a large circular medallion with a geometric, mandala-style pattern. The mandala incorporates gold, red, and blue elements arranged in repeating shapes radiating from a central blue circle, surrounded by a red ring and bordered by a wider blue ring. The overall arrangement is vertically centered and orderly, with the dominant colors being gold, red, and blue.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
